name: Café Boulud
dinnerNote: À la carte; mains $38–$72 (Menu du marché at lunch $60)
lunchNote: Menu du marché, 2 courses (3 courses $75), Wed–Fri

menus.name: Menu du marché
menus.note: Three courses $75. Wednesday to Friday, 12pm to 2:30pm; à la carte also served at lunch and weekend brunch

bookingOpens: Online on Resy, for parties of up to eight. Tables currently show about 30 days ahead.
walkIns: Walk-ins are welcome in the bar and lounge; a reservation is suggested for the dining rooms.
groups: Parties of nine or more, and bookings of its five private rooms, go through the events team (eventsnyc@danielboulud.com).
children: Pushchairs and prams cannot be accommodated in the restaurant.
photoAlt: The green Café Boulud awning over its entrance at 100 East 63rd Street, New York
